summary: Syncing a DFM or Result Selection method with ResQ now runs on the ArcRho Server instead of the network drive, so the review window opens in a fraction of the time.
details: Sync, Refresh, Keep Local, and the remote update no longer publish their request file and poll for the answer across the mapped drive; the ArcRho Gateway does that work next to the data and the Bridge answers it from local disk.
The comparison now reads each method file once instead of two and three times, which speeds up the review window even when the Gateway is unavailable.
A sync request now records the person who started it rather than the account the service runs under.
A Client PC without the Gateway keeps working exactly as before.
